_readme.purpose: GPI historical quarterly results used by the backtest (scripts/backtest.py). Hand-entered from SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1 releases; 'Same Store' = GPI's non-GAAP comparable-dealership metric (comparison base changes every year). After each GPI release add the new quarter here (and fill the actual in data/forecast-log.json).
_readme.street_consensus_note: Consensus/surprise figures come from vendor articles (Zacks via Nasdaq/Yahoo, Benzinga, FXEmpire) surfaced by web search — NOT from GPI's releases, and vendors disagree on the estimate and on the EPS definition. Only six quarters were collected; quarters before 2025Q1 have none (not estimated). Do not treat as authoritative.

q3_2026_street_estimate.note: vendor-reported consensus for the Oct 28, 2026 print; secondary source
